diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in 'false' for all content checks (C1-C5), meaning no agent was forced to make a decision based on hidden information. The model consistently defaulted to standard/conventional settings (e.g., 'full interview segment' and 'conventional open-floor audience question period') which, while not triggering the specific checks, indicates the current check definitions do not penalize the absence of PF1 or PF2.
